description: Every image source considered for the VetNexa dog and cat wound / skin-condition dataset. Licence, image count and labels were read from each source's own page on the date given. Only sources marked "included" are used.
rules: Dogs and cats only: images of humans or other animals are excluded.
Real photographs only: no synthetic, AI-generated or augmented copies.
Licence must allow reuse with attribution (CC0, Public Domain, CC BY 4.0, Apache 2.0). Unknown or missing licences are excluded.
Images are never scraped from arbitrary websites, because each photo there is under its own copyright.

sources.name: Classification of pet dog skin diseases using deep learning with images captured from multispectral imaging device
sources.content: Clinical skin images of 95 pet dogs photographed at a veterinary hospital with written owner consent: 23 bacterial dermatosis, 19 fungal infections, 23 hypersensitivity allergic dermatosis, 30 healthy.
sources.decision: included
sources.inspection_notes: Original clinical data from a research institute, published with a DOI; photos taken by the researchers with written owner consent. 10 frames per dog: pic0 is the white-light photo (used); pic1-9 are narrow-band multispectral frames (not used). The label file covers 62 of 95 folders; the other 33 are excluded.

sources.name: Dogs Skin disease dataset
sources.content: About 500 images in 4 folders (Bacterial_dermatosis 97, Fungal_infections 137, Healthy 119, Hypersensitivity). The author notes the dataset has flaws and should be checked before use.
sources.decision: included in the community tier (open licence, uploader-asserted); kept separate from verified data
sources.inspection_notes: Inspection on 2026-11-21 found this is a compilation: it re-uploads the Mendeley CC BY 4.0 images (including multispectral band frames) under CC0, contains photos from veterinary websites (e.g. "© SeniorTailWaggers.com"), collages, annotated images and rotated augmented copies. The CC0 claim cannot cover third-party photos.

provenance_levels.verified: Original data published by the people who took the photos (institution, DOI, consent statement).
provenance_levels.uploader-asserted: Community upload; the licence is the uploader's claim and the original photographers are unknown.
provenance_levels.uploader-asserted, contradicted: Inspection found images the uploader cannot have licensed (stock watermarks, copies of other datasets).

policy.reason: Inspection of community datasets on Kaggle and Roboflow found stock photos (Shutterstock, Alamy, Getty Images, CanStockPhoto), photos from veterinary websites, re-uploads of other datasets under a different licence, collages, annotated and augmented images. Their uploaders cannot license photos they did not take, so they cannot serve as evidence of lawful, real data.
